from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """A single company's profit data extracted from one financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company whose report this is")
    profit_total: float | None = Field(description="The '利润总额' amount reported in the document")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency of the amount, e.g., '元'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_data: list[CompanyFinancialData]
